title: Founder-Financed Launch Capital and 45-Day Innovation Reserve

management_model.founder_scope: Founder retains governance, ownership decisions, approval authority, and final authorization of capital allocation.
management_model.assistant_scope: Assistant supports financial modeling, engineering planning, documentation, risk controls, and review; it does not hold funds, operate a bank account, or execute transfers.
management_model.joint_execution_rule: Plans and repository records do not constitute financial execution; funds and account controls require evidence from the actual account or custodian.

bank_financing_claim_condition: Only if actual bank facility and loan documents substantiate a bank loan.

envelopes.name: Taxes, refunds, disputes and contractual obligations
Residual Innovation Fund reserve for 45-day lock

no_double_counting_rule: Cash allocated to paid obligations cannot simultaneously be represented as locked reserve. The 45-day lock applies only to the reconciled residual reserve after prior obligations and approved costs have been separated.

lock.trigger: Only after all prior envelopes are reconciled and the designated residual reserve has cleared and is available.

development_during_lock.spending_rule: Development may proceed only from a separately approved and budgeted operating envelope; the locked reserve itself is not available for spending.
development_during_lock.revenue_claims: Targets, proposals, and outreach are not revenue until contracts and collected payments are evidenced.

legal_guardrail: Does not override applicable law, customer rights, bank/custodian terms, tax or licensing obligations.
